title: No market price exists in this environment
what_we_observed: Four source classes were read or attempted for a price: the Week 10 schedule page (prints matchups, times, networks, records and FINAL scores; no line), the official injury report (designations only), a commercial odds feed (not reachable: the session network allowlist is github.com, registry.npmjs.org, pypi.org and their file hosts), and the prior session's published CSV, whose market and closing columns are themselves blank.
where_it_shows_up: market_line_side, market_line_total, market_line_moneyline_home, difference_side, difference_total, difference_moneyline_home on every row of originated_lines.csv; the whole market_* block of price_snapshots.csv
why_it_is_flagged: Requirements 4 and 7 are about the *difference* between our line and the market's. Without a market number the difference cannot be computed, and inventing one would make every downstream edge statistic fictional.
what_we_did_instead: The model columns are published in full; the market and difference columns are left blank with a status string and this flag id on the row. Four capture attempts are recorded in price_capture_attempts.csv so the absence is evidenced.
does_it_block_merge: no - a blank with a reason is a finished row, not an unfinished one
human_decision_needed: Approve a licensed odds source, or accept that edge/CLV stay blank (see suggestion D966-S01).

title: Open and close come from two different model versions
what_we_observed: The only earlier publication of these fourteen markets is the prior session's file at commit 46391f1 (model nfl_309921cc_v1). Our snapshots are nfl_d966f630_v1. The 26 two-snapshot markets therefore mix a model change with the passage of time.
why_it_is_flagged: Calling that movement a market move would be false: it is a rewrite, not a reprice. It is also the only movement the store can measure today.
what_we_did_instead: Published the movement with the model versions named on both rows and this flag id, and marked the strategy that trades on it (D966-STR-05) blocked until two snapshots share a model version.
does_it_block_merge: no - a blank with a reason is a finished row, not an unfinished one
human_decision_needed: Confirm whether cross-version movement should be excluded from the movement column entirely (suggestion D966-S06).

title: The prior publication left moneyline probability blank
what_we_observed: originated_moneyline_home_prob is empty for all fourteen of its rows; its own note reads: "Blank: requires a margin-distribution (spread of victory-margin) parameter that no official NFL page in this pack supplies."
where_it_shows_up: price_snapshots.csv prior_session_publication moneyline rows; open_close_table movement_status for the 13 live moneyline markets
why_it_is_flagged: It is the reason our moneyline has no opening number: the ledger cannot show movement into a blank.
what_we_did_instead: Emitted the blank prior row anyway - the absence is a row, not a hole - and derived the missing parameter from the verified results feed (dispersion.csv: sigma_pts 10.2808, rho -0.0659 at the Week 9 vintage).
does_it_block_merge: no - a blank with a reason is a finished row, not an unfinished one
human_decision_needed: nothing - the handling above is the decision

title: Position grouping into offence/defence/special-teams is ours, not the league's
what_we_observed: The injury report prints a position label per player (QB, LB, P, ...) and no unit. Grouping QB/RB/WR/TE/offensive line into 'offence' and LB/DE/DT/CB/S into 'defence' is our mapping.
where_it_shows_up: depth_of_replacement.csv unit; club_depth_rollup.csv offence_/defence_ columns; correlations D966-COR-06/07/08
why_it_is_flagged: A fullback or a long-snapper could reasonably sit either side of a unit split, and the club-level rollup inherits that choice.
what_we_did_instead: Published POSITION_UNIT in capture.py verbatim so the mapping is auditable, and every depth row keeps its raw position label next to the unit.
does_it_block_merge: no - a blank with a reason is a finished row, not an unfinished one
human_decision_needed: Approve the mapping or supply the unit definition to use (suggestion D966-S07).

title: No player statistics were collected, so prop legs cannot settle
what_we_observed: Team final scores are on the schedule pages we read; per-player statistics are on different pages that this session did not read.
where_it_shows_up: strategies.csv row D966-STR-10 (blocked, zero selections); correlation_exclusions.csv D966-CX-02
why_it_is_flagged: The brief asks for player-prop combinations. A prop parlay whose legs are graded by guessing is worse than no parlay.
what_we_did_instead: Specified the rule, gate-blocked it, and published zero selections rather than a fabricated settlement.
does_it_block_merge: no - a blank with a reason is a finished row, not an unfinished one
human_decision_needed: Approve the per-player statistics ingest (suggestion D966-S04).

title: Small n on every correlation and leaderboard row
what_we_observed: The verified results feed holds Weeks 7-10 only: 44 games, 88 team-games, and at the Week 9 vintage 43 games / 86 team-games. Correlation n ranges from 28 to 287 (the 287 is same-week game pairs, which are not independent draws).
where_it_shows_up: correlations.csv n and ci95_low/ci95_high; leaderboard_signal.csv n_legs_graded_excluding_pushes; leaderboard_staking.csv n_tickets_graded
why_it_is_flagged: Requirement 7 exists because a coefficient at n=28 is a hint, and the 95% intervals here are wide enough to contain both signs on several rows.
what_we_did_instead: Published n, the interval, the sample unit and an explicit floor (N_FLOOR = 20 graded legs). Rows below the floor are shown and labelled, not ranked.
does_it_block_merge: no - a blank with a reason is a finished row, not an unfinished one
human_decision_needed: Decide whether to backfill Weeks 1-6 before promotion thresholds are relied on (suggestion D966-S02).

title: Two strategies are in the catalogue with no input at all
what_we_observed: D966-STR-09 (market-edge side) needs a book price; D966-STR-10 (prop combo) needs player statistics. Both are published with status blocked and zero graded legs.
where_it_shows_up: strategies.csv, leaderboard rows with status blocked_no_input, validation_gates.csv rows that read not_evaluated
why_it_is_flagged: A leaderboard that silently omits the strategies it cannot run hides the gap; listing them with a reason is the honest version.
what_we_did_instead: Kept them in every table with their blocking reason, so the gate has something to refuse and the reader can see what is missing.
does_it_block_merge: no - a blank with a reason is a finished row, not an unfinished one
human_decision_needed: remove them only if the owner wants a catalogue of live rules only

title: Week 7 moneylines cannot be originated, and the ledger says so per row
what_we_observed: The moneyline needs a point-noise scale measured from finished games *before* the game. At the Week 6 vintage the feed has no games at all, so the model returns no moneyline for the 14 Week 7 games.
where_it_shows_up: originated_lines_graded.csv, price_snapshots.csv rows with market_flag_id D966-F10 (14 rows), leaderboard row D966-STR-03 n=30 rather than 44
why_it_is_flagged: Silently filling the gap with the Week 7 scale would be a look-ahead: the moneyline would be priced with information that did not exist at kickoff.
what_we_did_instead: Left them blank with the reason on the row. For the calibration statistics only (Brier, log loss), where no measurable scale exists at the vintage, the earliest measurable vintage is substituted and every such leg is labelled substituted_forward_from_vintage_7.
does_it_block_merge: no - a blank with a reason is a finished row, not an unfinished one
human_decision_needed: Approve the Weeks 1-6 backfill, which would remove the gap entirely.

title: Five players appear under a club that is not the one their position line names
what_we_observed: On the official Week 10 report: Myles Garrett, listed LB Green Bay, appears in the Rams table; Von Miller appears in the Cowboys table; Quenton Nelson, G Indianapolis, appears in the Seahawks table; David Njoku, TE Cleveland, appears in the Chargers table; Patrick O'Connell appears as LB for Seattle. title: Two official headlines disagree on Lamar Jackson's absence window
what_we_observed: One headline reads 'Report: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson to miss 6-10 weeks with groin injury'; another in the same capture reads 'Ravens QB Lamar Jackson out 6-9 weeks'.
why_it_is_flagged: The return window decides which week the replacement chain stops being used. The two numbers are not compatible.
what_we_did_instead: Published both headlines side by side with both URLs and no merged value. Nothing in the model uses a return date.
does_it_block_merge: no - a blank with a reason is a finished row, not an unfinished one
human_decision_needed: Pick which headline governs, or prefer the injury-report designation over both.
